goal: Skip inheriting project-wide batch.final_verification by default on non-critical standalone single_task runs unless explicitly passed or configured via batch.single_task_final_verification, and surface SupervisedSessionPort / BatchSessionPort "error" observations so child_session_reconciler dispatches at most two automatic recovery prompts per Kernel record revision for an unfinished Lane with no pending gate or conflict, per D3 of docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-2; meet D3.1 and BR-SCN-3 in docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/single-task-lane-decision.test.ts, tests/single-task-lane-batch.test.ts, tests/layered-config.test.ts, tests/unattended-contracts.test.ts. Done looks like: a routine or material plan_source === "single_task" run started without an explicit final_verification argument records batch.single_task_final_verification when configured (required) and otherwise records no commands with final_verification_required false, ignoring batch.final_verification; with no commands, declared derived-file checks still run and a failing one blocks checkout delivery; dist/drive-batch.md tells the Parent to pass only literally requested commands for a single task. Negative: a critical single_task run still inherits batch.final_verification as required; an explicit final_verification argument wins over config; multi-child Initiative batches still require batch.final_verification; malformed batch.single_task_final_verification (>8 items, empty string, or non-array) emits a config diagnostic and refuses lane_config_invalid.

Source BR-REQ-3; meet D3.2 in docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/supervised-session-conformance.test.ts, tests/batch-session-port.test.ts. Dependency direction: runtime/unattended depends only on BatchSessionPort while runtime/lane_sessions bridges SupervisedSessionPort implemented by fake, herdr, and herdr-core. Done looks like: fake, herdr, and herdr-core report state: "error" through SupervisedSessionPort and SessionPortAdapter; when an unfinished child with entry_submitted: true and no open decision or replan observes state: "error" for the first time at its current recordRevision in a generation, reconcileChildSession sends one recovery prompt and records the baseline marker, resetting on recordRevision progress. Negative: a second "error" at the same recordRevision in that generation sends no second prompt and escalates/parks; settled children or children with hasOpenDecision or hasReplan receive zero automatic recovery prompts.

scope_size_reason: Propagating the "error" session state requires touching SupervisedSessionPort, its three providers, SessionPortAdapter, BatchSessionPort, child_session_reconciler, and its synced dist reference doc together alongside single-task final_verification config.
